# Reseller Fee Calculator

> Free U.S. tools that estimate marketplace fees and the listing price needed to hit a target profit on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Etsy, Depop, and Vinted. All amounts are planning estimates in U.S. dollars.

## Calculators
- [Target profit reseller fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/): Free U.S. reseller fee calculator. Enter item cost, target profit, and shipping to see the listing price you need on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Etsy, and Depop.
- [Reverse price calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/reverse-price-calculator): Work backward from the profit you want. See the listing price required after fees and seller-paid shipping on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Etsy, and Depop.
- [eBay fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/ebay-fee-calculator): Estimate eBay seller fees, shipping costs, and net profit for U.S. resale sales. Enter your sale price and item cost to see exactly what you keep after fees.
- [Poshmark fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/poshmark-fee-calculator): Estimate Poshmark fees and net earnings for U.S. sellers. Enter your sale price, item cost, and shipping to see what you keep after Poshmark's commission.
- [Mercari fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/mercari-fee-calculator): Estimate Mercari fees, shipping, net payout, and profit margin for U.S. resellers. Enter your sale price and item cost to see what you keep on each sale.
- [Etsy fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/etsy-fee-calculator): Understand Etsy listing, transaction, payment processing, and Offsite Ads fees with a worked U.S. seller example and a calculator to estimate your payout.
- [Depop fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/depop-fee-calculator): Estimate Depop fees, shipping, net payout, and profit for U.S. fashion resellers. Enter your sale price and item cost to see what you keep after fees.
- [Vinted fee calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/vinted-fee-calculator): Calculate your Vinted U.S. seller payout. Vinted does not charge sellers a selling fee; buyers pay Buyer Protection. See what you keep after shipping.
- [Reseller profit calculator](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/reseller-profit-calculator): Estimate net profit on resale items after sale price, item cost, shipping, and marketplace fees. Compare profit across five U.S. marketplaces before you list.

## Comparisons
- [Poshmark vs eBay](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/poshmark-vs-ebay): Compare estimated Poshmark and eBay fees, shipping, net payout, and profit margin for U.S. resellers. See which marketplace pays you more on a specific item.
- [Depop vs Poshmark](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/depop-vs-poshmark): Compare Depop and Poshmark fees, shipping costs, and resale margins for U.S. sellers. Enter your item details to see which platform is more profitable.
- [Mercari vs Poshmark](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/mercari-vs-poshmark): Compare Mercari and Poshmark fees, shipping, and net profit for U.S. resellers. Enter your item details to see which marketplace leaves you more profit.

## Guides
- [Marketplace fee guide](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/marketplace-fee-guide): Learn the main marketplace fees, shipping costs, and profit traps that quietly cut into resale earnings across eBay, Mercari, Poshmark, Depop, and Etsy.
- [Reseller tax guide](https://www.reseller-fee-calculator.com/reseller-tax-guide): Learn how state sales tax, resale taxes, and profit tracking affect U.S. seller earnings, and what to estimate and record before you list new inventory.

## Fee assumptions used by the calculators
- eBay: 13.6% of the total sale amount (item price plus buyer-paid shipping) for most categories, plus $0.30 per order of $10 or less and $0.40 per order over $10. The percentage also applies to sales tax collected from the buyer, which this calculator does not include. Some categories have different rates.
- Poshmark: On Poshmark the buyer pays shipping separately and it is not part of the 20% fee, so enter $0 for shipping unless you offer a shipping discount.
- Mercari: The 10% fee applies to the item price plus buyer-paid shipping and includes payment processing. Instant Pay costs an optional $3.
- Etsy: Offsite Ads: 15% of the order total if your shop earned under $10,000 in the past 365 days, and 12% once it reaches $10,000, capped at $100 per order. At $10,000 or more the program is required, and the 12% rate stays even if sales later fall below $10,000. Below $10,000 you can opt out.
- Depop: Depop charges no selling fee in the U.S. The 3.3% + $0.45 is payment processing. Optional Boosted Listings cost 12%, which this calculator does not include.
- Vinted: sellers pay 0% commission in the U.S.; buyers pay Buyer Protection.

## Notes
- Estimates are for planning only. Verify current rates with each marketplace before listing.
